description: This Java source file defines the SandboxingContextFactory class responsible for creating customized Rhino JavaScript execution contexts with sandboxing features, including instruction counting, time limits, and stack depth restrictions. It also contains an inner class to track execution time.

classes.name: SandboxingContextFactory
classes.description: A final class extending ContextFactory to produce Rhino JavaScript contexts configured for sandboxing execution with size and time constraints.

classes.name: StartTimeAwareContext
classes.description: Inner static class extending Context to store and manage execution start time for time limit enforcement.

methods.name: makeContext
methods.description: Creates and configures a new StartTimeAwareContext with sandboxing parameters such as optimization level, instruction observer threshold, language version, and stack depth.

methods.name: hasFeature
methods.description: Overrides feature detection to enable FEATURE_MEMBER_EXPR_AS_FUNCTION_NAME in the JavaScript context.

methods.name: observeInstructionCount
methods.description: Monitors JavaScript instruction count and throws an Error if the script exceeds the maximum allowed execution time.

methods.name: doTopCall
methods.description: Overrides to set the start time for script execution before invoking the superclass method.
